- L-004: Annotate refusal-auditing service methods with `@Transactional(noRollbackFor = ContractProblemException.class)` and use 2-argument `Objects.requireNonNull(dep, "dep must not be null")` in constructors.

Milestone row (`docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`):
- Milestone: `P2 — MVP / Core Features`
- Milestone file: `docs/agents-v0/milestones/p2-mvp-core-features.md`
- Story: `P2-C`
- Feature artifact: `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-c-iam-user-directory-onboarding-exports.md`
- Dependency: `P2-B`
- Surface: `backend`
- Size: `8`
- User story (copy verbatim):
  `As a platform administrator, I want user filtering, role assignments with optional expiry, self-lock protection, Google Workspace or mock directory lookups, zero-role Role Apply onboarding submission, and user/role CSV access review exports, so that workforce access lifecycle and compliance reviews are centrally governed.`

OpenAPI endpoints in `openapi/api-v1.yaml` for Story `P2-C`:
1. `GET /api/v1/iam/users` (`listUsers`): offset pagination (`page`, `limit`) and optional `search` query param (`maxLength: 128`, case-insensitive filter across `workspace_email`, `display_name`, `department`), returning `UserListResponse` (`HTTP 200 OK`, `X-Correlation-ID`).
2. `GET /api/v1/iam/users/{id}` (`getUserById`) and `PATCH /api/v1/iam/users/{id}` (`updateUserStatus`):
   - `GET /api/v1/iam/users/{id}` returns `UserResponse` (`HTTP 200 OK`, `ETag`, `X-Correlation-ID`) with `roleAssignments` (`UserRoleAssignmentDto`).
   - `PATCH /api/v1/iam/users/{id}` accepts `If-Match` and `UserStatusUpdateRequest` (`isActive`, `department`, `version`, `additionalProperties: false`), updates user active status and/or department with optimistic concurrency (`ETag` / `version`), enforces admin self-lockout prevention (`HTTP 409 Conflict` or `HTTP 403 Forbidden` with `errorCode = "SELF_LOCKOUT_PREVENTED"` when an administrator attempts to deactivate their own user account `isActive = false`), revokes active sessions or blocks access for deactivated users, records `IAM_USER_STATUS_UPDATED` in `audit_log_entries`, and returns `HTTP 200 OK` (`UserResponse` with updated `ETag`).
3. `PUT /api/v1/iam/users/{id}/roles` (`updateUserRoles`):
   - Accepts `If-Match` and `UserRoleAssignmentsUpdateRequest` (`assignments` array of `{roleId, expiresAt}`, `version`, `additionalProperties: false`), validates all referenced `roleId`s are active (`is_active = true`, `deleted_at IS NULL`) and any optional `expiresAt` is in the future, evaluates Segregation of Duties (`ROLE_MUTUAL_EXCLUSION`) via `SodConflictEvaluator` (`IamSodEvaluationPort`), enforces admin self-lockout prevention (`errorCode = "SELF_LOCKOUT_PREVENTED"` when an administrator attempts to remove or expire their own active `ADMIN` / IAM administrative role assignment), updates `user_role_assignments` (marking removed assignments inactive with `revoked_at = now()`, inserting/updating active assignments with optional `expires_at`), exposes `IamRoleGrantPort` (value-typed port in `com.example.app.iam.port` per `L-003`) for atomic role provisioning, records `IAM_USER_ROLES_UPDATED` in `audit_log_entries`, and returns `HTTP 200 OK` (`UserResponse` with updated `ETag`).
4. `GET /api/v1/iam/directory` (`searchDirectoryUsers`):
   - Accepts `query` (`minLength: 2`, `maxLength: 128`), `page`, `limit`; queries corporate workspace directory profiles via `DirectoryLookupAdapter` (`DirectoryLookupPort` — Google Workspace Directory in production profiles or deterministic mock directory profiles in `local`/`test` profiles; fails closed with `HTTP 503 Service Unavailable` and `errorCode = "DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE"` when upstream directory fails or circuit breaker opens), returning `DirectoryUserListResponse` (`HTTP 200 OK`, `X-Correlation-ID`).
5. `POST /api/v1/iam/role-applications` (`submitRoleApplication`):
   - Accepts `Idempotency-Key` header and `RoleApplicationCreateRequest` (`requestedRoleIds` `minItems: 1`, `maxItems: 10`, `justification` `10..1000` chars, optional `expiresAt`, `additionalProperties: false`); accessible to authenticated zero-role users (`redirectView = "ROLE_APPLY_ONBOARDING"`) and operators requesting access expansion; validates all `requestedRoleIds` are active non-deleted roles and passes `SodConflictEvaluator` (`ROLE_MUTUAL_EXCLUSION` against existing + requested roles); creates/stages an `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION` governance ticket (`status = "PENDING_APPROVAL"`) and returns `HTTP 201 Created` (`GovernanceTicketResponse` with `X-Correlation-ID`), recording `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION_SUBMITTED` in `audit_log_entries`.
6. `GET /api/v1/iam/exports/users` (`exportUsersCsv`) and `GET /api/v1/iam/exports/roles` (`exportRolesCsv`):
   - Streams deterministic UTF-8 CSV reports (`Content-Type: text/csv`, `X-Correlation-ID`) with CSV formula-injection neutralization (prefixing cells starting with `=`, `+`, `-`, `@`, `\t`, `\r` with a single quote `'`) for user access review (`exportUsersCsv`: users, status, department, lastLoginAt, active role codes, assignment expiry) and role/permission matrix (`exportRolesCsv`: roles, system/active/deleted flags, mapped permission codes, HTTP methods, route patterns), recording `IAM_USERS_EXPORTED_CSV` and `IAM_ROLES_EXPORTED_CSV` in `audit_log_entries`.
7. Negative / Edge scenarios (`AC-7`, `AC-8`):
   - `AC-6` (`Kind: edge` or `happy`): CSV access review exports (`GET /api/v1/iam/exports/users`, `GET /api/v1/iam/exports/roles`) and expired role assignment exclusion (`expires_at <= now()` excluded from effective permissions while preserved in history).
   - `AC-7` (`Kind: negative`): Self-lockout refusal (`SELF_LOCKOUT_PREVENTED` when an administrator attempts to deactivate their own account via `PATCH /api/v1/iam/users/{id}` or remove/expire their own `ADMIN` role via `PUT /api/v1/iam/users/{id}/roles`, audited as `IAM_SELF_LOCKOUT_REFUSED`), unauthorized caller refusal (`403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN`), and `View-As` read-only overlay mutation refusal (`403 VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN` on `PATCH /api/v1/iam/users/{id}`, `PUT /api/v1/iam/users/{id}/roles`, `POST /api/v1/iam/role-applications`).
   - `AC-8` (`Kind: negative`): SoD `ROLE_MUTUAL_EXCLUSION` conflict refusal on `PUT /api/v1/iam/users/{id}/roles` and `POST /api/v1/iam/role-applications` (`403 SOD_CONFLICT_DETECTED`, audited as `SOD_CONFLICT_REFUSED`), unknown user `{id}` (`404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`), stale `If-Match` (`412 CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT`), payload version mismatch or duplicate pending role application (`409 CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT`), invalid/inactive `roleId`s, past `expiresAt`, short directory `query` (`< 2` chars), missing `Idempotency-Key`/`If-Match`, or unknown JSON properties (`400`/`422 VALIDATION_ERROR`), and directory outage (`503 DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE`).

Ensure all 8 ACs (`AC-1` through `AC-8`), Preconditions, Desk check, Out of scope, NFRs (citing `docs/agents-v0/design/system/nfr-slo.md` including `<= 400 ms` read, `<= 800 ms` mutation, `<= 600 ms` access review export), Security-review triggers (`RBAC`, `auth`, `any {id} path`, and sensitive actions), Regulations, `Open questions: none`, and `## Delivery approvals` (with empty Approver/Decision/Date for `Intake` since user has not approved yet) are written to `docs/agents-v0/requirements/p2-c-iam-user-directory-onboarding-exports.md`. Do NOT write `.phase-result.md` (the main session will write it).

#### User Story
> As a platform administrator, I want user filtering, role assignments with optional expiry, self-lock protection, Google Workspace or mock directory lookups, zero-role Role Apply onboarding submission, and user/role CSV access review exports, so that workforce access lifecycle and compliance reviews are centrally governed.

#### Acceptance Criteria Summary (`AC-1` – `AC-8`)
| ID | Kind | Summary |
|----|------|---------|
| **AC-1** | `happy` | `GET /api/v1/iam/users` offset pagination (`page`, `limit` up to `100`) and case-insensitive substring search across `workspace_email`, `display_name`, and `department`. |
| **AC-2** | `happy` | `GET /api/v1/iam/users/{id}` and `PATCH /api/v1/iam/users/{id}` (`If-Match`, `UserStatusUpdateRequest`) updating active status/department, revoking active Redis sessions on user deactivation (`SessionStorePort`), and auditing `IAM_USER_STATUS_UPDATED`. |
| **AC-3** | `happy` | `PUT /api/v1/iam/users/{id}/roles` (`If-Match`, `UserRoleAssignmentsUpdateRequest`) and value-typed `IamRoleGrantPort` (`L-003`) for role assignment/revocation with optional future `expiresAt`, `SodConflictEvaluator` verification, and `IAM_USER_ROLES_UPDATED` audit logging. |
| **AC-4** | `happy` | `GET /api/v1/iam/directory` (`query` `2..128` chars, `page`, `limit`) via `DirectoryLookupPort` (Google Workspace Directory in deployed profiles / deterministic mock profiles in `local`/`test`). |
| **AC-5** | `happy` | `POST /api/v1/iam/role-applications` (`Idempotency-Key`, `RoleApplicationCreateRequest`) for zero-role onboarding (`redirectView = "ROLE_APPLY_ONBOARDING"`) or access expansion, verifying `SodConflictEvaluator`, creating a `PENDING_APPROVAL` `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION` governance ticket, and auditing `IAM_ROLE_APPLICATION_SUBMITTED`. |
| **AC-6** | `edge` | `GET /api/v1/iam/exports/users` and `GET /api/v1/iam/exports/roles` streaming UTF-8 CSV reports (`text/csv`) with spreadsheet formula-injection neutralization (`'`), auditing `IAM_USERS_EXPORTED_CSV` / `IAM_ROLES_EXPORTED_CSV`, and excluding expired `user_role_assignments` (`expires_at <= now()`) from effective session permissions while preserving historical rows. |
| **AC-7** | `negative` | Refusal of administrator self-deactivation and self-admin-role removal/expiry (`HTTP 409 SELF_LOCKOUT_PREVENTED`, audited as `IAM_SELF_LOCKOUT_REFUSED` with `noRollbackFor` per `L-004`), unauthorized callers (`HTTP 403 AUTH_FORBIDDEN`), and mutating calls under an active `View-As` overlay (`HTTP 403 VIEW_AS_MUTATION_FORBIDDEN`). |
| **AC-8** | `negative` | Refusal of SoD conflicts (`HTTP 403 SOD_CONFLICT_DETECTED`, audited as `SOD_CONFLICT_REFUSED`), unknown user `{id}` (`HTTP 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`), stale `If-Match` (`HTTP 412 CONCURRENCY_CONFLICT`), version mismatch / duplicate pending ticket / idempotency conflict (`HTTP 409`), invalid/inactive `roleId`s / past `expiresAt` / short `query` / missing headers / undeclared JSON fields (`HTTP 400` / `HTTP 422 VALIDATION_ERROR`), and corporate directory outage (`HTTP 503 DIRECTORY_UNAVAILABLE`). |

- **Regulations:** BSP Circular 982 / 1019, Philippines Data Privacy Act of 2012 (RA 10173) & GDPR, Internal GXI Enterprise Governance & Security Baseline (`security-baseline.mdc` §1, §2, §3, §5, §7, §8, §11, §12; VAPT F4, F8, F9, F10).
- **Security-Review Triggers:** `RBAC`, `auth`, `any {id} path`, and sensitive actions (user status toggle, role assignment/revocation, self-service role application submission, and access review CSV export).
- **Open Questions:** `none`
